title.value: EU-PS-L1-B - Level 1b: Maximum metadata and empty sections

description.value: The serving system provides an EU-PS for its level 1b test patient, in which all metadata is present, and all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative explaining the empty reason. Conformancelab sends the bearer token you enter at test setup to your server. Use a token issued by your own system that gives access to your level 1b test patient, and only to that patient. Without a token the server may return the Patient Summaries of several patients; the script then tests the first one. Implementation Guide: https://build.fhir.org/ig/hl7-eu/eps/
